title: Tamsin and the Horizon
author: Silas Kavanagh
blurb: Mara Kavanagh, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
